scope: A documented family shopping visit, not an accessibility audit. No purchases, prices, staff interactions, feline encounters, individual reactions or sponsorship history asserted without owner context.
observations: Exterior yellow building and autumn flowers.
Wooden stairs and handrails to an upstairs antiques area.
Lamps, wicker furniture, quilts, baskets and records in the photographed displays.
Posted keep-cats-inside instruction; no cat encounter documented.
Donation entrance sign gives Saturdays noon–3 p.m. and asks not to leave goods unattended.

firsthand: The family met a lovely, inveterate thrifter.
He said this was the absolute best store he goes to.
He told the family about $1 clearance walls at the side and back of the store.
owner_visit_context.scope: The best-store statement and clearance tip are attributed to that shopper, not presented as a measured ranking, store-wide pricing policy, verified current stock or an owner purchase.
